ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name Talkbook (Talkbook AI Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.talkbook.example
Location Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Incorporated February 2026
One-line description AI call summaries and automatic CRM updates for Indian sales teams,
including code-mixed languages.
Sector (as selected) Consumer tech
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 8
Founders
Founder 1 Arun Kumar, CEO. 6 years as a product lead at a CRM software company.
linkedin.com/in/arun-kumar-example
Founder 2 Meenakshi S, CTO. 4 years in speech ML at a speech-technology
company. linkedin.com/in/meenakshi-s-example
Time commitment Both full-time since March 2026.
Prior startup experience None.
Equity split Founders 95%, ESOP 5%.
Product and traction
What have you built? A call-recording and transcription layer for sales teams, with summaries
and CRM field updates. Handles Hindi-English, Tamil-English and Telugu-
English calls.
Customers 16 paying teams, 340 paid seats.
Revenue MRR INR 1.9 L (INR 500 per seat per month).
Unit economics CAC about INR 48,000 per team, including founder time at a nominal
salary. Gross margin 70%. Payback about 5 months.
Customer acquisition Founder-led outbound brought 9 teams, referrals 5 and CRM
consultants 2.
Competition Gong and similar global tools, and meeting note-takers like Otter and
Fireflies. We do not know of an India-first player.

Key risks Telecom call-recording restrictions, accuracy on noisy calls, and
customer concentration in BFSI.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 2 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 12 Cr post-money
Existing investors None.
Use of funds Engineering and language models, sales, security and operations.
Other investors in
conversation
One pre-seed fund.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We would value introductions to sales leaders at Indian BFSI and edtech companies.
